unlisted_practices: Conduct experimental manipulations of chatbot usage duration in future AI therapy research to assess its causal influence on psychosocial outcomes.
Use change-over-time outcome measures in future AI therapy chatbot studies.
Define placebo conditions more clearly in future AI therapy chatbot trials.
Include comparison groups receiving conventional psychological treatment in future AI therapy chatbot trials.
Stay alert to early signs of overreliance on AI therapy chatbots, particularly among vulnerable populations.
Invest in careful, incremental studies to guide responsible, evidence-based implementation of AI therapy chatbots.
